DonorNode.title: DonorNode
DonorNode.description: Publicly queryable blood donor beacon and availability status on the Rokkhon Bangladesh map.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the donor.

isAvailableDonor.description: Whether the user is currently active and ready to donate blood.

contactPhone.description: Voluntary emergency contact number for blood donation requests.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate on the Bangladesh map.

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate on the Bangladesh map.

trustScore.description: Community accountability and anti-false-alarm score (0 to 100).

networkKey.description: Network partition key for secure list queries.

BloodRequest.title: BloodRequest
BloodRequest.description: Clinical urgent blood request in Bangladesh with Hemoglobin, Problem/Diagnosis, Hospital, Ward/Cabin, and Required Date/Time.

userId.description: UID of the user requesting blood.

unitsNeeded.description: Number of blood bags needed (1 to 10).

hemoglobinLevel.description: Patient hemoglobin level in g/dL (e.g., 6.8 g/dL).

patientProblem.description: Medical problem or diagnosis (e.g., Dengue Shock, Thalassemia, C-Section, Trauma).

hospitalName.description: Hospital or clinic name in Bangladesh.

wardCabinNumber.description: Ward, Cabin, ICU, or Bed number.

contactPhone.description: Emergency contact number at the hospital.

urgencyLevel.description: Urgency level of the blood request.

status.description: Whether the request is still open or fulfilled.

respondersCount.description: Number of donors who pledged to help.

networkKey.description: Network partition key for secure list queries.

SosAlert.title: SosAlert
SosAlert.description: Zero-effort emergency SOS alert triggered via 3x Power/Volume/Shake or 1-tap with automatic 3-second silent camera & audio blackbox attachment.

userId.description: UID of the person in distress.

senderName.description: Name of the person triggering SOS.

hasLiveCameraVerification.description: True if 3s silent camera blackbox snapshot attached.

hasLiveAudioVerification.description: True if 3s silent audio blackbox clip attached.

triggerMethod.description: How SOS was triggered (e.g., 3X_POWER_BUTTON, 3X_VOLUME_KEY, SHAKE_SENSOR, ONE_TAP).

status.description: Current status of the SOS alert.

networkKey.description: Network partition key for secure list queries.

VoteMarker.title: VoteMarker
VoteMarker.description: One-per-account marker for blood request pledges, SOS responders, and SOS false alarm reports.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the voter/responder.

/donor_nodes/{userId}.description: Publicly queryable donor availability beacons keyed by userId.

/blood_requests/{requestId}.description: Urgent clinical blood donation requests across Bangladesh.

/blood_requests/{requestId}/pledges/{vot.description: One-per-account donor pledge markers for a blood request.

/sos_alerts/{alertId}.description: Emergency SOS alerts with 3s silent camera/audio blackbox verification.

/sos_alerts/{alertId}/responders/{voterI.description: One-per-account responder markers for an SOS alert.

/sos_alerts/{alertId}/false_reports/{vot.description: One-per-account false alarm report markers for an SOS alert.
